home.heading: Hi, I'm Erdan!
home.intro: I'm a Product Manager passionate about building products that solve real problems for real people. With experience spanning fintech, healthtech, and marketplace products, I combine analytical thinking with user empathy to drive outcomes that matter.
home.personal: When I am not working you can find me playing soccer, watching documentary films, or building side projects. I enjoy learning how things work and how they can be made better.
currentWork: I'm currently pursuing an MBA and MS in Digital Technology at Boston University's Questrom School of Business, while building products and taking on PM roles. Most recently, I worked as a Product Manager Intern at Rae Health, where I defined the company's first North Star metric and supporting metric tree for a live clinical wearable platform.
previousWork: Before graduate school, I spent nearly four years as a Senior IT Project Manager at Attract Group, where I owned discovery-to-launch for 10+ client products across fintech, marketplace, and healthtech — managing cross-functional teams of up to 15 engineers and specialists.
On the side, I've been building the PM Thinking Coach — a learning app with a structured PM skill tree, 159 lessons, 36 simulation scenarios, and a 515-term glossary, built on SwiftUI and FastAPI.

projects.title: PM Thinking Coach
projects.description: A learning app built from problem statement to a working end-to-end product: a PM skill tree of structured learning blocks and interactive decision scenarios to learn and evaluate your seniority level, on a SwiftUI client with a FastAPI + Postgres backend.
projects.imageAlt: PM Thinking Coach — the Map screen showing the skill tree of six domains across three rings
projects.caption: The Map — six domains across three rings, with the recommended next block on the right.
bullets: Designed scoring to reward reasoning over answer-picking: rationale and communication carry 60 of 100 points against 25 for the decision itself
Covered 7 competency tracks across three proficiency levels: product sense, analytics, user research, prioritization, execution, communication, and system design
Total of 159 lessons, 36 simulation scenarios, and a 515-term glossary
Implemented an audio overview feature that narrates lessons and coaching feedback for hands-free review
Defined the beta success metrics: activation, time to first value, D7 repeat practice, and feedback usefulness
